articleTitle: Improving The Operational Reliability Of Stamped Parts Of Electrical Engineering Machines And Electrical Products
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The durability and operational reliability of electrical machines, electronic and electrical engineering products in almost all cases can be achieved by imparting special properties to the materials used. In addition, it is extremely important to choose the most rational, economical method of treating materials that provide a high operational reliability and quality of the produced parts. Among a large variety of physico-chemical nature of the impact on the material of a workpiece, the stamping methods have received very a intensive development in the field of influence on the structure and operational properties of the latter. The performance characteristics of the parts of electrical machines and electronic products from a thin-sheet material largely depend on the accuracy of punching and the size of the burr. In addition to the traditional technologies for cutting and punching in hard dies, and with the help of the elastic or liquid media the explosive forming is also used.The advantages of the explosion forming when performing the dividing operations are due to the absence of a gap between the deforming medium and the die. The use of the pulsed metalworking methods in the cutting operations of the sheet metal forming eliminates the nonflatness of parts during the cutting, the formation of burrs and sinkers, forms in terms of the use of the overlaid explosives, a fine and ultrafine-grained material structure. This increases the electrical resistance of steel, reduces the parasitic eddy current losses and the efficiency of the electrical heating elements.

articleTitle: Development of Theory and Practice of the Local Autonomous Power Supply Sources Creation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The approach to creation of the local autonomous power supply sources for increase of reliability of power supply systems, generation, transformation and transmission of energy to consumers is formed in the work. The proposed solutions improve existing power systems in the event of emergencies through systemic or accidental power failures of critical facilities. The developed programs for the formation of local autonomous power supply sources, which are created in emergencies and are completed with regular electrical equipment, which is in constant production operation of local enterprises or institutions. The practical implementation of the local autonomous power supply source, created on the basis of a scooter and an induction motor with capacitive self-excited induction generator, is presented.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Composition of Voltage and Current of Induction Generator with High Saturation Magnetic System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a mathematical model that allows to take into account the influence of physical phenomena, such as the nonlinearity of the magnetization curve, the hysteresis and eddy currents, on the dynamic characteristics of an induction generator. The advantages of the model include the possibility of studying the spectral composition of the output voltage and current at various degrees of saturation of the magnetic system. The change in the harmonic coefficient and its compliance with the permissible boundary values was analyzed.

articleTitle: Identification Of Changes In The Parameters Of Induction Motors During Monitoring By Measuring The Induction Of A Magnetic Field On The Stator Surface
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents an analysis of the measured induction of the magnetic field on the stator surface of an induction motor, according to monitoring data, and signal extraction, which reflects the change in motor parameters to predict its condition, period and further operation. “Step- detection” algorithms allow you to determine the point of change of parameters. It is established that the process of analyzing the signal is influenced by noise caused by the presence of working electrical equipment and its on-off. Conducting a signal filtering with a moving average method with different weights can double the accuracy of the result. The combination of the Changepoint and CUSUM methods for determining the point of change of the signal can significantly improve the accuracy, as well as the calculation of the values of the initial and final signal levels. For this, the signal change point is localized based on the cumulative sum method by the CUSUM function, and then refined using the Changepoint function. The results obtained allow us to quantify the performance of the induction motor.

articleTitle: Development of a Moderator of the Pump Controlled Drive for the Engine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers an actual problem associated with the automatic regulation of uneven rotation rating of diesel engine fuel pump camshaft on an operating engine in order to improve the performance of vehicle engines operating part load and at partial speed rates. To improve diesel engines technical performance, a device has been proposed that allows to control special drive of vehicle's diesel pump camshaft uneven rotation. For this purpose, an additional moderator has been developed that changes the maximum gearing ratio and the injection advance angle depending on engine crankshaft rotational rate.

articleTitle: Numerical Determination of Active Magnetic Bearings Force Characteristics Taking into Account Control Laws Based on Parametric Modeling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper proposes a technique for a numerical determination of power characteristics of active magnetic bearings (AMBs), taking into account control laws. It is based on an application of the finite element method for analyzing static electromagnetic fields. Electromagnetic forces are calculated using the Maxwell's stress tensor. As an example, two types of bearings are considered with the given control laws. These are an axial AMB of a bilateral action with stators in the form of pot cores and a radial AMB with an eight-pole stator. The results of computational studies for a determination of the dependences of forces and stiffness coefficients on a rotor displacement for various control parameters are given. A practical applicability of the methodology for calculating the base force and stiffness characteristics of AMBs is proved by comparison with experimental data. The technique can be used for a selection of rational or optimal AMB parameters and parameters of the control laws for them.

articleTitle: Optimization of Business Processes with the use of Industrial Digitalization
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article explores the impact of changes in the organization of production due to digital innovations in the case of enterprise business models. The authors investigate the essence of digital tools as IoT, monitoring system, ERP, predictive modelling and services available to businesses as well. The authors consider that the shifts in industrial digitalization will allow enterprises to implement the integrated policy of managing digital changes, which will help to optimize business processes, to ensure the necessary level of transparency in the functioning and compliance with the foundations of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Digitalization of Electrical Engineering Education and Automatic Assessment of Study Results
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The advantages and drawbacks of the known ways of identification of the users of E-learning systems during the registration and performance of the tasks and tests are analyzed. A new method for the automatic assessment of the results in electronic learning systems is proposed. This method provides the use of a personal confidential accumulating coefficient for the participants of the test as an identification means. Iterative formulas for calculating an individual cumulative confidence coefficient are proposed. It is shown that the proposed method allows to detect violation of the testing rules in 95% of cases.

articleTitle: Accuracy Improving of the Two-Speed Elevator Positioning by the Identification of Loading Degree
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Improved transportation comfort, energy efficiency and safety are the top priorities for the modernization of electric drives of the elevator industry. Promising is the transition from two-speed electric drives to frequency-controlled single-speed, which, in its turn, is associated with significant material costs. Therefore, the search for alternative variants of elevator electric drives reconstruction is relevant. Based on the experiments carried out on the mathematical model, it is determined that the developed method for identifying the loading degree of the elevator cabin allows to increase the accuracy of its positioning to ±5 mm due to the change start time of braking.

articleTitle: Administrative Buildings Heating Automatic Control Based on Maximum Efficiency Criterion
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This study describes the method of increasing the efficiency of the automatic heating control system and reducing the financial costs to maintain sufficient climatic conditions in administrative buildings which is considered through the formation of optimized heating system regimes based on a complex efficiency criterion. The computer model that simulates physical processes in the heating system was implemented and allows to study and confirm the adequacy of the proposed method for determining the system's performance.

articleTitle: Development of a Mathematical Model for Power Engineering Parts Deep Drawing from Two-layer Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the modern power engineering equipment the required set of properties frequently can be achieved by combining several materials into a single structural unit. Currently, layered metals are one of the most modern and promising materials used in power engineering. One of the promising tasks of the layered metals use increasing is the development of new methods for determining their mechanical properties during plastic deformation, as well as the improvement of theoretical and experimental methods of forming and obtaining finished products from layered compositions.

articleTitle: Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor under Conditions of Parametric Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the paper the description of the Field Oriented Control with cascade control of electromechanical coordinates of synchronous electric drive is presented. The control algorithms components of the stator current and the speed of Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine that had developed on the basis of the concept of inverse problems of dynamics allowed obtaining high dynamic performance of quality control in conditions of parametric uncertainty. The simulation results had confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed method control coordinates of electrical drive.

Author Keywords: Surface Mounted Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis by STM32 Microcontroller of the Mixed Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article describes the realization of Fast Fourier transform Radix-2 for STM32F746ZG microcontroller and measurement of its precision. A measured frequency spectrum is compared with the professional spectrum analyzer by BitScope system. Whereas the square signal contains a lot of harmonics, measured precision is provided by this signal type. The article describe also speed comparing between Fast Fourier transform and Discrete Fourier transform. The result table shows ten measurements of various sample numbers with their transformation time. The end of article contains time comparing of our FFT with Radix-2 and ARM library FFT with used Radix-8.

articleTitle: Harmonization of the Interests of Employers and Institutions of Higher Education as a Basis for the Sustainable Regional Development
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Modern institutions of higher education are gradually moving away from the traditional model of providing educational services to the model of conscious provision of educational services and the implementation of scientific research taking into account the needs of the region. In the conditions of university autonomy, the possibilities of taking into account the expectations and needs of employers regarding the competencies of their staff in the development of curricula and programs are expanding. The purpose of the paper is to justify an approach that will harmonize the interests of employers and institutions of higher education in terms of sustainable regional development. The research methods are: analysis and synthesis (for determining theoretical and practical aspects of ensuring the quality of the educational process); expert survey (for determining the most effective forms of interaction between business and universities); abstract-logical method (for theoretical summarization and conclusion); graphics (for visualization of the model of providing educational services on the basis of harmonization of interests of employers and institutions of higher education). The results of the research: forms of cooperation between universities and companies; the model for forming the competencies of specialists as a basis for ensuring their attractiveness in the labor market. The proposed approach allows effective management of educational activities on a systematic basis, improves the quality of education, and contributes to sustainable regional development.

articleTitle: Combined Rotor Suspension in Passive and Active Magnetic Bearings as a Prototype of Bearing Systems of Energy Rotary Turbomachines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents a laboratory rig of a rotor in a combined passive-active magnetic-electromagnetic suspension. It is a prototype of complete magnetic suspensions of small and medium-sized rotary machines, such as turboexpanders and pumps. A physical implementation was performed for one of possible variants of a full magnetic suspension of the rotor, including one axial active and two radial passive magnetic bearings. Methods, algorithms and discrete control devices were developed for an active magnetic bearing. A proposed computer system for measuring and processing signals that characterize a vibrational state of a rotary machine allows to control dynamic parameters. The detailed experimental data represent the laboratory rig parameters.

articleTitle: Evaluating Effectiveness of the Business Models of Electrical and Electronic Engineering Companies: Monitoring Methods, Experience and Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper investigates theoretical, methodological and analytical aspects of developing of the business models. Synthesis of the theoretical fundamentals of the business model concept allows distinguishing the key characteristics comprising a temporary combination of all internal elements and subsystems, the focus on creating value and profit, defining the methods of implementing the companies' strategy. In addition, the author researches the key characteristics of business models of electrical and electronic engineering companies. The analysis of business models conducted on the basis of the developed author's methodology is considered to allow other companies to increase the efficiency of business processes through the implementation of the comprehensive approach to analysis and the electrical and electronic engineering companies' experience relating to the business model development.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Efficiency Energy Saving Solutions Implemented in the Buildings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Comparative analysis of various energy-saving solutions implemented in the existing engineering systems of buildings was carried out. The analysis was based on an improved discounted method combining the indicators of the classical method (the net value, profitability index, internal rate of return and discounted payback period) and the breakeven criterion which considers technical features of various energy saving technologies. The research was conducted on one of the health care institution facilities with nine options of engineering systems modernization. The author's tool for assessing energy-saving technologies implementation effectiveness allowed not only to evaluate individual decisions, but also to compare and rank them according to the breakeven rate for the efficiency implementation decline. Obtained results can be used as a separate part of the building modernization feasibility study.

articleTitle: Calculation of No-load Currents Using Hysteresis Loop
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: An improved approach has been applied to increase the efficiency of field simulation of the research no- load mode by setting the conditions of symmetry of the magnetic field on a plane with the axes of the limbs of the magnetic system. Harmonic composition of the phase no-load currents are determined. The features of non-sinusoidal changes in time of momentary values of no-load currents are determined. It is shown that the amplitude of the main harmonic decreases for the positive phase-sequence by 5.08% of the amplitude of the transformer no-load current and increases to 27.91% for the negative phase-sequence. The prevailing influence of the odd higher harmonic components of the no-load phase currents are established. The use of a compensating winding system, which is connected to the adjusting windings, reduces the effective value of the no-load current of the negative phase-sequence; approximates the effective value of the first harmonic of the no-load current; reduce the deviation of the phase shift angles compared to the symmetric idle mode up to 2%.

articleTitle: Export-Oriented Enterprise Development of the Electrotechnical Industry: Strategic Guidelines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article reflect the prerequisites for exportoriented enterprise development of electrical engineering in Ukraine. An economic and statistical study of innovation in industrial enterprises and capital investment in electrical equipment production was carried out. The problems and prospects of innovation and investment development of exportoriented industries of Ukraine are identified. Research methods: specific methods of economic analysis, of mathematical statistics, econometric methods.

articleTitle: Pd/Porous GaAs in the Manufacture of Schottky Diodes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: GaAs: Sn - GaAs: Si samples with a porous layer formed on their surfaces have been explored. It has been identified that an increase in the anodizing current density leads to an increase in the uneven structure of the porous layer, and when the current density is greater than 60 mA / cm 2, clusters are formed as a result of fragmentary separation of the porous layer from the substrate. The spectra analysis has proved that PL intensity increases with porosity growth. To identify the influence of the porous layer morphology on the Schottky contact parameters, the I-V characteristics of the structures have been explored. It has been discovered that with layer porosity increasing, the difference in characteristics between the structure without porous GaAs and structures with porous GaAs increases, that results in direct current decreasing and reverse current increasing. This can be explained by the decrease in the GaAs porous layer, and, as a consequence, by the decrease in the charge carriers density. The height of the Schottky barrier for Pd / porous GaAs with different morphology of the porous layer was calculated. It has been found out that the height of the Schottky barrier increases from 0.65 to 0.73 eV with a porous layer thickness. It has been established that the increase in the porous layer thickness leads to the rise of the ideality factor, which grows from 1.24 to 1.7 with the layer height and results in a deterioration of Schottky contact parameters.

articleTitle: Increase in Use Values of Future Engineers through the Education Technology Trends Implementation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the ways to increase the use values of future engineers. The forecast of the most sought after educational technologies are considered Global Education Market Expenditure was identified. An overview of innovative educational trends has been made such as Blockchain, Virtual Reality and Augmented reality, artificial intelligence and 3D printing. The state of implementation of technological trends in the Ukrainian educational process was analyzed.

articleTitle: Magnetic Fields of DC PM Motor and its EMC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is presented the mode of computer analysis on the electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) problems in the electrical machines area and means for its improving. It is also discussed the problem of interference between electric motor and environment caused by electromagnetic field radiation.

articleTitle: Rationalization of Professional Orientation of a Person According to the Needs of the Business
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Nowadays most higher educational establishments do their best to encourage the university entrant to make him/her take advantage of their services. When choosing their professional future the university entrants take into consideration the specialties included into the education standards and not the posts. Thus, there is no relationship between the consumer's choice and the needs of the business. The paper proposes an instrument enabling an entrant to make a rational choice of the future profession according to the needs of the labor market. From the point of view of rationality, low educational pragmatism of a person results from incorrectly posed purposes and chosen methods for their realization. The identification of the person's educational needs and the employer's needs for personnel revealed a multifold excess of the number of posts and staff positions in comparison with the number of specialties. This circumstance is the main proof of the possibility to make the List.

articleTitle: Renewable Energy Policy in Ukraine's Household Sector: Measures, Outcomes and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper investigates state support policy to promote renewable energy development in Ukraine's household sector. The key economic mechanisms aimed at encouraging electricity generation from renewable energy resources are described. The impact of state support policy on deployment of small renewable energy plants in household sector is analyzed. The main shortcomings of legislation and barriers towards large-scale installation of small renewable energy power plants by households are outlined. The recommendations to eliminate a number of organizational and economic obstacles that slow down this sector development are given.

articleTitle: Formation of Informational Support in Construction for the Implementation of Energy Saving Measures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article is devoted to the formation of informational support in construction. The problems of a methodological nature and an empirical nature, which hamper the development of the construction complex and the implementation of energy saving measures, are considered. The paper proposes approaches to the formation of indicators that allow analysing the situation in construction and implement measures for energy saving. The construction complex functioning is characterized by a huge massive of data. Such situation force us to search for the methods allowing to structure information without the loss of information value.

articleTitle: The Design and Simulation of Spiral Planar Coil in COMSOL Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to calculate the inductance of a spiral planar coil. COMSOL Multiphysics software was used to calculate the inductance. The article describes the design of the spiral planar coil in the simulation program with the results of the simulation. Next it is described the design of the spiral planar coil based on the simulation parameters and its production of a 3D FDM printer using a special metal-polymer composite containing a copper particles. The results obtained by simulation, calculation using the equations and the produced real spiral planar coil were compared.

articleTitle: Axial Asynchronous Motor With A Rotor Two-section Cone-cylindrical Magnetic Circuit
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The possibilities of improving the axial asynchronous engine by formation of two-section magnetic circuit and rotor winding with radial conical surfaces of teeth, tangential displacement of the core parts of sections and intermediate short-circuiting rings are shown. The displacement of the core sections of winding within of the toothed division limits is equivalent to the slots slope of machines with a cylindrical gap and weakens the electromotive forces and additional moments from the higher harmonics of the magnetic field. The condition for sectional components of the rotor currents compensation from the magnetic field toothed harmonics is obtained.

articleTitle: The Standardization of the Higher Engineering Education in Ukraine in the Light of American Experience
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the analysis of the problematic issues of the creation of the system for the provision of the high quality of higher education in Ukraine at the state level. The system of engineering program accreditation in the educational establishments of the USA is shown. The fundamental differences between the engineering and engineering technology training programs are analyzed. The reasonability of such separation and the necessity for the determination and use of different criteria during the accreditation of these programs are stated. Attention is drawn to the necessity for the development of professional standards at the state level and the subsequent creation of higher education standards for the formation of the policy in the field of training a specialist who will be competitive at the labor market.

articleTitle: Accreditation of Higher Engineering Education in the USA: American Scientists’ Estimation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper examines the system of accreditation of higher education institutions in the United States on the example of engineering and engineering technology majors. The works by American scholars concerning the mentioned problem are analyzed. The activity of ABET as the leading organization, which carries out accreditation of engineering and engineering technology majors, is determined. Consolidated review of the process of accreditation genesis as a means of the educational services quality monitoring is provided. The significance of accreditation as approach for education quality improvement is determined. Some weaknesses and drawbacks of the accreditation process in American higher education institutions from the point of view of American scientists are noted.

articleTitle: Idling Mode Simulation of Single-Phase Transformer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A unifying mathematical model of the single-phase transformer is developed. This model superposes the external electrical circuit and an electromagnetic fields model, which describing the processes of electromagnetic energy conversion in a transformer. The model is able to take into account the hysteresis effects, eddy currents, design parameters and parameters of the external circuit, that forming the complex effect on the processes and parameters of the transformer. The adjustment of the reference parameters of the hysteresis loop based on the Jiles-Atherton model is carried out according to testing data. Comparison of simulation results with testing data showed high accuracy of the unifying model. The error in the amplitude of the idle currents is less than 0.38%, the phase - 0.45%. The error on the idling losses is less than 0.78%.

articleTitle: Sustainable Energy Supply Based on Sunflower Seed Husk for Oil mills
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The use of biomass, including sunflower husk, for in-situ energy generation has undergone a development in Ukraine last decades. Within this work, four combined heat and power technologies based on oil utilization, husk combustion, gasification, and methanization have been investigated. Their electricity and heat potential has been determined. Criteria for techno-economical assessment of CHP technologies have been suggested. Husk biogas and gasification technologies are not mature. CHP plants based on husk combustion are competitive. Steam turbine generators with a nominal electric capacity higher 1.5 MW may be profitable too.

articleTitle: Dependence Of The Indicators Of Three-phase Transformers With Planar Plate Magnetic Wires From Variants Of Rod Configuration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Traditional and circular of forming the contours of the cores of the magnetic cores and winding coils are characterized by known disadvantages. The possibility is shown and the digital values of reducing the mass, cost and active power losses of three-phase transformers and reactors with planar lamellar magnetic cores are shown when replacing the circular forming loops of rods and winding coils with hex and octahedral loops.

articleTitle: Application of Monitoring of the Informational and Educational Environment in the Engineering Education System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article considers the possibilities of educational monitoring of the results of training of higher education applicants in the engineering specialties in the terms of the informational and educational environment. The monitoring system of the informational and educational environment includes the monitoring of the work of higher education applicants and the monitoring of the work of professors. The management of the educational process in the informational and educational environment is carried out using statistical data, which are formed as a result of the passing of course and the use of interactive electronic educational tools by higher education applicants. The statistics takes into account the attendance of higher education applicants, the review of educational content, the index of discrimination and the easiness factor. There is an opportunity to correct the educational content, forms and methods of its submission in the terms of the informational and educational environment on the basis of the received data. The means of monitoring the training of higher education applicants of engineering specialties in the terms of the informational and educational environment are also considered. These include methods of assessment, analysis of responses and statistics. These tools help applicants and professors to adjust further actions and create educational content.

articleTitle: Creating the Educational and Research Software for Integrated Assessment of Energy Consumption and Sustainable Development of Regions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A new approach which determines the level of sustainable development of the country and its individual regions taking into account the development of the energy sector and energy security of the country is proposed. The authors present their own research and development of software that comprehensively takes into account social, environmental, economic and energy indicators for assessing the sustainable development of the country. The algorithm of base indicators calculation for a comprehensive assessment of energy consumption and sustainable economic development and their correlation is developed. The results of the study can be used in the educational process and in the professional activity of future specialists in the field of electrical engineering to systematize information on the level of energy consumption of the country and calculate its sustainable development.

articleTitle: Active Suspension Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the presentation of one of the approaches to nonlinear systems control. Such an approach allows using well-known methods of linear control theory to synthesize robust controller for nonlinear objects. The above-mentioned approach is based on interval approximation of a nonlinear function by piecewise linear functions. The above-mentioned functions simplify the mathematical model of control object and allow us to take into account possible parameters drift and unmeasured external disturbance effect. We offer to reduce domains where these functions are defined by performing the minimization of some energy cost function. This minimization allows us to decrease energy consumption from a power source and increase live tine of the autonomous object. Then, we use an interval model to solve an inverse dynamic problem and define a control algorithm, which is based on using sliding mode control methods. Usage of the closed-loop control systems, which are developed in the proposed way, allows us to form the transient and steady state of control object with desired characteristics.

articleTitle: Simulation of Random Loads Applied to Statistical Optimal Synthesis of Electric Drives
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The classification of loadings which are changed according to random laws for electric drives of agricultural and communal purposes is described in this article; the statistical characteristics of electric drives are determined. Such loads can be reduced to stationary random processes and can be approximated by one of four classes of random functions. The models of loads in the form of forming filters are presented, the structure and parameters of which depend on the class of loads. These models can be used for the optimal synthesis by statistical characteristics of electric drives, which work with random loads.

articleTitle: Matlab Model and PI Controler of DC Permanent Magnet Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The simulation of DC motor operation using correct model can be used to predict its behaviour in different conditions. Therefore, we performed measurements of the DC motor parameters and based on the results we have proposed the model of DC motor in Simulink software. In addition, we expanded our model by PI controller. In our model, we simulated regulation of DC motor using PI controller and subsequently we realized proposed regulation on our DC motor. This application required extension by measuring the speed using encoder. The encoder is design specifically for the DC motor type and then printed by a 3D printer.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Energy Efficiency of Pressure Stabilization Cascade Pump System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The character of change of the efficiency and power losses in pump systems under the conditions of stabilization of the rated pressure with the use of efficiency observers based on neural networks are investigated. Typical variants of construction of water supply systems and technological cycles are considered, which include a single pump system and a cascade scheme with two parallel-connected pumps, the total capacity of which corresponds to the capacity of a single-pump system. The investigation considered the likely character of changes in water consumption within the daily cycle for both systems. The results and analysis of studies of the level of energy losses in electromechanical pumping systems are presented.

articleTitle: Half Bridge Driver for MOSFET and IGBT Transistors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the problem of designing a suitable driver for MOSFET and IGBT transistors. The circuit should provide not only sufficient excitation but also galvanic separation of the power and control circuit and should be able to set the optional length of the safety gap when switching the transistors connected in one converter branch.

articleTitle: Four Leg Interleaved DC-DC Buck-Boost Converter with Modifiable Topology Using Proposed Windows Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper is briefly describing proposed windows application. For these purposes the windows application can be called GUI (Graphic User Interface). With the help of proposed GUI the four legs interleaved DC-DC Buck-Boost converter can be controlled as follows. The topology changing, efficiency determining, manual controlling and data acquisition in real time can be done easily. The paper also provides a brief description of used converter, used MCU (Microcontroller Unit), data processing and data handling between PC and MCU. The advantage of proposed GUI is that it can be also used for different types of DC-DC converters.

articleTitle: Possibility of the Optimal Control Method Application in Energy-Consuming Technological Processes of RED Production
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The search for effectiveness criterion for resource and equipment use of energy-consuming technological processes for RED components production makes it possible to determine the most effective target operation. This paper considers the possibility of applying existing techniques to the reflow soldering process. A possible change in the position of the control optimum with a change in the cost estimate of one or several input products is considered.

articleTitle: Coaching as Education Technology on Electrical Engineering Education
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The use of core principles and methods of coaching as an education technology in higher education will make it possible to create fundamentally new approaches to the Electrical Engineers students training. The use of coaching in higher education is especially important, since it allows to maximize the inner potential of the individual, and to develop competencies corresponding to the current requirements of the global labor market. The basic purpose of the paper consists in working out the theoretical and methodological principles of coaching as education technology on electrical engineering education. To achieve this purpose the methods of monographic and structural-logical analysis were used. Consequently the existing experience was generalized, the educational coaching goals and objectives were determined, as well as its main ideas, concepts, principles and regularities. Moreover the scheme of educational coaching actors' interaction was designed.

articleTitle: Development and Verification of Dynamic Electromagnetic Model of Asynchronous Motor Operating in Terms of Poor-Quality Electric Power
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Three-phase asynchronous motor with a short-circuited rotor has been described with the help of a model convenient for the analysis of changes of its power indices in terms of different values of all the indices of supply voltage quality. Mathematical model of electromechanical converter with the power of 11 kW has been verified based upon the results of industrial experiment in the workshop of “Ukrspetsservis” Ltd. While checking the validity of the model, the obtained values of relative mean square error of modeling make it possible to be used for the purpose of computational studies of asynchronous electric motor energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Control of Passing the Resonance Zone During Start-up of Above Resonance Vibration Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The features of the start-up of the electric drive of an above resonance vibration machine were considered. The possibility of using a variable-frequency electric drive to pass the resonance zone while starting the vibration machine was substantiated. It was noted that in the case of using drive motors in above resonance vibration machine with a capacity calculated for a stable operation, it is necessary to ensure an increase in the torque of the motors while overcoming the resonant zone. To increase the torque of the drive motors during the start-up process, the use of a linear law of frequency control and a sharp steplike increase in the supply voltage when approaching the resonance zone was proposed. Experimental studies of the formation of the frequency start-up of above resonance vibration machines in a laboratory setup were carried out.

articleTitle: Tool for Automatic Formulation of State Equations in the MATLAB Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with an educational tool for automatic formulation of state equations for linear nondegenerate circuits in the MATLAB environment. The procedure of formulating the state equations for circuit is not based on the topology concept but on knowledge, that if the values of state variables are known at a certain time instant and the values of input variables thereafter, then the value of any state variable can be determined for any subsequent time. The tool formulates state equations automatically in a symbolic form without numerical values of elements for given circuit. After substitution of numerical values of elements into the state equations, their analytical solution and graphical representation of complete responses are given.

articleTitle: The Methods for Accounting the Degree of Electric Machines Aging in the Assessment of their Reliability
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The classification of the conventional methods for the assessment of the reliability from the point of view of the possibility of their application to different degrees of mean time between failures of electric machines is performed. The specific features of the processes of aging of the basic structural units and the methods for their accounting at the assessment of electric machines reliability are substantiated. The approaches to the development of the reliability model and the calculation of its basic characteristics, taking into account the real condition of electric machines and their main structural units, are systemized.

articleTitle: The Usage of a Waste Heat Recovery Metal-Hydride Unit of Continuous Operation in the Maritime Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The perspectives of waste-heat recovery of low-speed diesel engines using metal-hydride units of continuous operation have been substantiated. The design scheme of a unit and parameters of operating environment have been described. The results of mathematical modeling of processes in a waste heat recovery metal-hydride unit have been represented. The work efficiency of a waste heat recovery metal-hydride unit as a part of a marine propulsion complex on the basis of a low-speed dual-fuel diesel engine has been revealed. The novelty of this study is the investigation of metal hydride technology for application in the gas fuel compressor drive of LNG-powered ships.

articleTitle: The Analysis Of Modulation Algorithms and Electromagnetic Processes in a Five-Level Voltage Source Inverter with Clamping Diodes
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article focuses on the study of modulation algorithms and implemented quality parameters of the output voltage and output current in a five-level voltage source inverter (VSI) with clamping diodes. Methods of implementation of space-vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) pulse width modulation (PWM) are considered. A new variant of the implementation of the PWM is investigated. In the Matlab/SymPowerSystems environment, a model of a five-level VSI with the proposed modulation algorithms was developed. The results of simulation in the form of energy characteristics and indicators of emission of higher harmonics of current and voltage to the load and supply network are obtained. A comparative table of energy parameters of a five-level VSI in single modulation mode and pulse-width modulation with different topologies is presented.

articleTitle: Induction Motors Condition Monitoring and Lifetime Estimation System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study methods for induction motor diagnosis and reliability analysis. Remaining lifetime definition is an important problem that needs to be solved. Effective diagnosis allows preventing serious damages, unplanned operation stoppage and significantly reduce operational expenses. Methods and equations that have been revised in the article describe reliability of induction motor parts with highest breakings rate. Automotive system that analyzes incoming sensors data may seriously simplify reliability evaluation process. Fuzzy logic system with a certain number of rules for these induction motor parameters is an effective solution.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Two Types of Generators with Permanent Magnets for Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The results of numerical studies of two types of permanent magnet electric generators for wind turbines are given: multi-pole with an external rotor; integrated with a magnetic gearbox. For given sizes of the generator (outer diameter of the stator, axial length of the stator), the configuration and dimensions of the magnetic system of the gearbox are determined, at which the maximum power value is reached for the specified speed range of the wind rotor n = 100 ÷ 200 rpm. The dependences of voltage and power of two types of generators are determined when they are connected via a rectifier diode bridge to an active load. It is shown that with identical stator sizes, the generator with an integrated magnetic gearbox has about 10 times more power than a multipole generator with an external rotor, while the mass of active materials of the generator with a magnetic gearbox is only 1.8 times larger than that of an external rotor. The calculation of the characteristics of the studied generators is made in the software packages Simcenter MagNet and Simcenter MotorSolve.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Intelligent Air Quality Sensor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article focuses on the design and implementation of an intelligent air quality sensor capable of monitoring temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide (CO2) concentration, dust particles and smoke. These are the key parameters necessary for the proper functioning of the ventilation system in intelligent buildings. Since it is a wireless sensor, communication with the control system takes place via the Wi-Fi network, using the modern MQTT protocol. The visualization of the measured data is realized in real time using the Home Assistant IoT platform.

articleTitle: Test-object Activity and Mortality Depending on Electromagnetic Radiation Intensity and Duration
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The standardization of electromagnetic pollution of environment in Ukraine in comparison with other states is considered. The expediency of using the model organism Daphnia magna Straus for the determination of the level of negative influence of electromagnetic radiation is proved. An express method for evaluating the impact of this stress factor is described, and the results of experimental studies of its harmful effects on the test object are presented. The stimulating, suppressing and lethal doses of electromagnetic pollution for the test object are determined. A new method for the operative determination of electromagnetic pollution levels in the nature reserve fund territories within a city has been tested. On the base of the results obtained, it is proposed to develop a national system for the standardization of negative effects on biota.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Required Electrotechnical Properties during Recycling of Worn Trolley Wire
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents information about the level of production of copper contact wires for trams and trolleybuses, their electrotechnical and strength properties, the most common shapes of wires used in transport. These wires are worn during operation; the initial shape is reduced in cross section, which decreases from 100 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> or 85 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 30 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Recycling of the worn contact wire allows manufacturing copper wire of round and rectangular cross-section, which is in great demand in the tram and trolleybus depots. The technology of wire recycling consists of its rolling according to the rhomb-oval scheme and cold drawing with the drawing ratio of 1.14...1.31 in one pass. Rolling of round section with a diameter of 5.5...8.5 mm (depending on the initial wire cross section) is formed after 2...5 passes at a rolling speed of 2.04 m/min. Cold drawing allows making a round wire with a diameter of 1.2...7.5 mm and a wire of rectangular section (4 mm × 2 mm) from a round pre-rolled bars with diameter of 5 mm. Electrical resistivity, mechanical properties and microhardness allow to use the received wire for the manufacture of winding wire for electric brakes and motors coil and other electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Robust Anisotropic Control by Cable Winding Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The method of feed-forward robust stochastic anisotropic control synthesis by cable winding machine is developed. Mathematical models of cable winding machine as multi-mass electromechanical systems with plant parametric uncertainty and random perturbations is developed. The synthesis of anisotropic regulators is reduced to the solution of the system of four related Riccati equations. The results of modeling of the dynamic characteristics of a synthesized robust anisotropic control by cable winding machine are presented. Use of synthesized robust anisotropic controllers has allowed to improve the control accuracy parameters and to reduce the sensitivity to plant parameters changes in comparison with the existing system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Centralized Access Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Access system allows authenticated persons to enter restricted areas. The paper describes proposed and realized centralized access system with remote control possibility. The authentication is based on RFID technology using MFRC522 module and access system is based on client/server communication between ESP8266 and centralized database. The goal of the project is to show possibility where todays IoT modules can be used also as a main controller not just as a communication interface. It allows more efficient integration and cost save solutions. The research is focused to create multi-node IoT system supporting client-server, but also peer-to-peer communication.

articleTitle: Three-phase Grid Inverter for Combined Electric Power System with a Photovoltaic Solar Battery
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of the paper is providing with the compliance of the IEC standards for the harmonics composition of the grid current at the point of common coupling to grid the inverter and load in the maximum range of current values. Dependences for the amplitude of the pulsations of the inverter current and the error on the fundamental harmonic, when using PWM, according to the voltage at the input of the inverter, the modulation frequency and inductance of the output reactor are obtained. Based on this, the parameters of the inverter current control loop are determined. It has been established that with constant parameters of the current control loop and the use of a nonlinear reactor, the inductance of which depends on the amplitude of the inverter current, the energy losses in the inverter switches increase several times or the harmonics composition of the grid current deteriorates significantly. In accordance with this, it is proposed to change the coefficient of proportional link of the current control loop according to the amplitude of the inverter current reference. At low values of the grid current, the modulation frequency increasing is desirable. The structure of the control system with a corresponding change in the parameters of the current control loop in the case of using a non-linear reactor is proposed. The simulation of the “grid - inverter - load” system was performed with a linear and non-linear reactor with an estimate of the power losses in the inverter switches.

articleTitle: Adaptive Position Control and Self-Commissioning of the Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper a new position tracking control algorithm for interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSM) with decoupling of direct current component and angular position is presented. It allows to freely regulate the direct current component in order to achieve more efficient control without degradation of the speed and position dynamics. A novel three stages self-commissioning procedure is proposed for all IPMSM parameters identification. For each testing stage, the adaptive algorithms are designed. First two stages are based on adaptive current control. Adaptive position controller provides the estimation of the mechanical parameters. Simulation results proof the effectiveness of the theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Mechanical Press Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents a method of analytical analysis of the dynamics of a mechanical press based on a phased calculation of engine parameters. Each stage of the drive operation is characterized by specific functional conditions of the system, various external power factors. Depending on the external load, a solution to the problem is proposed by using various representations of the mechanical characteristics of the engine. The presented method of analysis allows to determine the actual characteristics of the drive, depending on the design factors of the drive and the conditions of technological loading of the press.

articleTitle: Optimal Field-Oriented Control of an Induction Motor for Loss Minimization in Dynamic Operation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The problem of minimizing the power consumption of an induction motor (IM) operating from a frequency converter in vector control mode is considered. This contribution presents an application of a nonlinear gradientbased model predictive control (GRAMPC) scheme for induction motors to provide the desired rotor flux in an energy efficient way over a wide operational range. The method has the same formulation as for the optimization of power in the steady-state conditions of operation as well as the reduction of the peak power losses under step change in the load torque on the shaft of the motor. Simulation results show the robustness and performance of the control scheme.

articleTitle: Predictive Control of Electrical Equipment Reliability on the Basis of the Non-linear Canonical Model of a Vector Random Sequence
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Method of individual prediction of electrical equipment reliability on the basis of the analysis of the probability of no-failure operation at future moments of time is offered. A posteriori probability of no-failure operation is calculated using the statistical modeling of the realizations of a vector random sequence of the change of the parameters of electrical device in the prediction area. Relative frequency of the number of realizations belonging to the area of allowable values of the parameters of an electrical device is taken as the estimation of a sought a posteriori probability. Statistical modeling is performed on the basis of non-linear canonical expansion of a random sequence. Taking into full account of stochastic relations and properties of electric equipment parameters is a substantial advantage of this mathematical model which will allow to achieve maximum accuracy of the solving of the problem of predictive control of reliability.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Relationship between the Parameters of the Nonlinear Object of Control and its Transfer Function of the Fractional Order
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the search for the interrelations between the parameters of the nonlinear object of control and the fractional order transfer function by which it is identified. A series excitation direct current motor is used as a nonlinear object. The moment of inertia and the moment of resistance on the motor shaft and the supply voltage were assumed to be the parameters of variation. Their change influences not only the quantitative indices of the transfer characteristic but also the qualitative ones. FOMCON MATLAB Toolbox is used for the identification of the coefficients of the fractional order transfer function. The obtained results testify to the existence of the relationship between the motor parameters and the coefficients of the fractal function. The obtained dependences are exponential for the moment of resistance and extreme for supply voltage and the moment of inertia.

articleTitle: Searching of The Optimum Configuration of The Traction Electric Transmission of The Shunting Locomotive
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Now about 98% of shunting locomotives of Ukraine are morally or physically worn-out therefore there is a need for development and probe of new types of traction electric drives for locomotives. New designs of traction drives have to conform to the existing requirements for energy efficiency and environmental safety. The choice of the optimum configuration of transmission becomes complicated existence of a large number of alternative options of realization of all its components. For the solution of objective, the method with the application of the generalized function of desirability of Harrington was used. As the basic structure of traction electric transmission of shunting locomotive the hybrid system with stores of energy which allows increasing efficiency of locomotive considerably is accepted. In research options of execution both diesel-generator installation and the traction electric drive are presented.

articleTitle: Simulation of Processes in the Modular Multilevel Inverter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: One of the important aspects of improving energy efficiency at the moment is the widespread introduction of a adjustable-speed electric drives for motors with a medium rated voltage. One of the actual ways of development in this direction is to research the methods for controlling a modular multi-level inverter, since it has a number of valuable advantages for the implementation of such a system. The main advantage of this scheme can be the possibility of a modular implementation based on the same types of cells with identical parameters. The disadvantage is that the entire load current of the converter passes through the capacitors of its modules, causing a change in the voltage on them. The paper presents the results of modeling the operation of the circuit at high and low frequency of the output voltage. An analysis of the main dependencies describing the processes in a modular multilevel converter is presented.

articleTitle: Modern Aspects of Alternative Energy in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article analyses the modern conditions of renewable energy and the prospects for its further development. The preconditions for stimulating the energy transition and the potential of using the renewable energy sources in terms of regions are investigated. Leading countries experience in the field of alternative energy is considered. The prospective regions of Ukraine which could use one of the main renewable energy sources as a factor for overall energy efficiency improvement of the country are determined. Future directions of the state policy development in the field of alternative energy stimulation under modern conditions are offered. There are the following research methods are used: induction method, systems thinking, dialectical method, statistical methods.

articleTitle: The Influence of the Phase Angle Between the Rotor Magnetic Axis and the Stator Winding Current Vector on the Synchronous Reluctance Motor Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Modern transport technologies require the use of highly efficient AC motors. One of these machines are synchronous reluctance motors (SRM). When designing a SRM, it is necessary to determine the main parameters with reliable accuracy. The article presents a refined equivalent circuit of a synchronous reluctance motor, which allows calculating the motor torque and stator current with high accuracy, a method for determining the longitudinal and transverse resistance when solving the problem using the finite element method is proposed. To evaluate the proposed methods, the article provides a comparative analysis of the calculated design parameters of the SRM and experimental results.

articleTitle: Simulation of Static Stability of Synchronous Electric Drive at Hardly Variable Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: electric drives; rotors; machine control; computer aided instruction; further education; stators; induction motors; educational courses; educational institutions; machine vector control.

articleTitle: Formation of Scientific and Research Competence of Future Electrical Engineers
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Technology training of future electrical engineers is proposed, which will contribute to the formation of scientific and research competence The relevance of the formation of scientific and research competence of future electrician engineers is substantiated and inadequate level of its formation is revealed; the basic research skills essential for electrical engineer are specified and the definition of research competence is formulated; the technology of formation of scientific and research competence of future electrical engineers in the course of professional disciplines is proposed and its contest is described. The criteria for the proposed technology implementation effectiveness are determined. The results of pedagogical experiment, which prove scientific and research competence of future electrical engineers, based on professional orientation using active teaching methods are presented.

Author Keywords: criteria for evaluating scientific research competence

articleTitle: The Frequency Response Research of Power Part Elements a One-Phase Series Active Power Filter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Many social and economic activities depend on the quality of electrical energy. Therefore, it is necessary to compensate distortion of electric energy by filtration of harmonics a current and voltage. In the case of a distortion of the supply voltage form, regardless of the nature of these distortions, a series active power filter is used. Serial power active filter according to the single-phase circuit, which includes transistor converter, passive filter, transformer, network and load. Due to the lack of recommendations for selecting filter and transformer parameters, the goal is to study their frequency characteristics for the formation a current and voltage in network winding of transformer. Using the quadripole method, the parameters of the equivalent quadripole in the complex form are calculated. A family of frequency characteristics is constructed. Analysis of these characteristics allowed formulating criteria for selecting a filter and transformer with equivalent substitution schemes. The results of research can be used to substantiate the method of selecting the equipment of the series active filter.

articleTitle: Wind Energy Conversion System with Induction Generators Connected to a Single Static Compensator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper a new configuration of a wind energy conversion system (WECS) supplying power to the dc-link regulated load is presented. The system is developed with two induction generators (IGs) connected to variable speed wind turbines (WTs). With the aim to concentrate the IGs power flow control in one unit and reduce the installed in WT gondola equipment weight a single static compensator (STATCOM) outside WTs is used. Based on the vector control technique the IGs power flow controller is proposed. Simulations are performed to validate the capability of the system to supply dc load at two operation modes.

articleTitle: Implementation of Dual Education Elements Into Electrical Engineers Training
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The ways of implementing dual education into the training of electrical engineers are researched. The advantages of dual education for the enterprise and the university are studied. The novelty of the research lies in the characterization of the elements of dual training of future electrical engineers. With the use of dual education, the university introduces relevant technologies into education, which positively influences the further development of the educational process, which ultimately contributes to raising the prestige of an educational institution. The necessity of pedagogical support of students participating in the dual program is substantiated. The implementation of the dual program of training electrical engineers involves the creation of a new teaching position - Student Adviser (consultant or curator). The functional responsibilities of Student Adviser are highlighted.

articleTitle: Reproduction and Development of Personnel Potential of Electrical and Power Engineering in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The quantitative and qualitative characteristics of training qualified specialists in the field of knowledge “Electrical engineering” in the conditions of modernization of Ukrainian higher education and development of the economy in the context of European integration and globalization are analyzed. It is found out that quantitative characteristics in view of the scope of education by levels and specialties, and the variety of sources of funding, etc. are generally enough to meet practical economic needs and at the same time insufficient to provide innovative development of electrical and power production. The critical insufficiency of competitive quality of education in electrical and power engineering is argued. The state of the implementation of standardization and accreditation based on the competence approach and Standards and Guidelines for Quality Assurance in the European Higher Education Area is revealed. A more progressive rating mechanism for improving the quality of higher education in general and in the field of knowledge “Electrical Engineering” in particular, is proposed.

articleTitle: Regions of Attraction for Two Hidden Attractors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Paper presents the regions of attraction of two hidden attractors occurring in the dimensionless model of the Chua's circuit. For a long time it was thought that there is no attractor in the system; later, only one, so-called hidden attractor was discovered. In fact there are up to two hidden attractors close together. Therefore, not only the regions of attraction of two hidden attractors are shown in the paper, but it is pointed out the need to choose the right size and location of the test cuboid for detection the hidden attractor. At the same time, it is pointed out how the accuracy of Matlab solution can lead to (un)detection of two hidden attractors.

articleTitle: Transporter Control for Grain Handling in Granaries and Loading on Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper substantiates the possibility of dropping grain at a given range by creating an appropriate ballistic flight trajectory by adjusting the rotational speed of the electric motor of the transporter when powered from the frequency converter. The mathematical model of the electric drive is made, which allows to carry out research of dynamic regimes at frequency start with linear frequency scanning. The synthesized astatic system with the PI controller of speed provides compensation for static and stabilization of the rate of throwing grain for various grain crops, regardless of its mass. The practical application of the proposed control system will reduce the loss of grain when damaged. The tasks of further research are formulated.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of English Language Training for Electrical Engineering Students at Ukrainian Universities
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the issue of English language training for electrical engineering students at Ukrainian universities. Understanding the importance of studying foreign languages has been confirmed by a number of normative documents. The curricula of seven leading universities of Ukraine training electrical engineering students have been analysed. The recommended time for studying foreign languages and the study load at Ukrainian universities differ significantly. The content analysis of existing English language coursebooks and textbooks for engineers, electricians, electrical and power engineers has been conducted to find out the content of foreign language training. Recommendations for the improvement of teaching English for professional purposes at Ukrainian universities have been proposed.

articleTitle: Application of Energy Storage Systems at the Traders Work on the Ukraine Energy Market
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The analysis of the main energy storage systems that can be used by traders to improve their work in the electricity market in Ukraine was carried out in this paper. The features of the energy storage systems operation in the conditions of the Ukrainian electricity market are considered. The criterion of economic efficiency of using energy storage systems for the traders work in the electric energy market has been developed. The most effective energy storage systems for the traders work in the new liberalized market of electric energy in Ukraine are determined using the proposed criterion.

articleTitle: Non-stationary Electromagnetic Processes in power-Intensive Electrical Facilities with Highly Varying Loads
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: we have shown that the operation of electric arc steel-melting furnaces cause non-stationary and ferroresonant electromagnetic processes in supplying electrical facilities, which are frequently the reason of the decrease in their technical-and-economic efficiency. We have presented the findings of theoretical and experimental researches of non-stationary electromagnetic processes in the power supply system of arc steel-smelting furnaces, including power transformers and thyristor-based compensators of reactive power.

articleTitle: Currents System for Efficient Mathematical Modeling of an Induction Motor Using the Field Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The expressions for determining the rotor currents of the circular model are given using the field analysis with existence of the spectrum harmonics of the stator magnetomotive force (MMF). Expressions were developed for the definitions of winding data and the appropriateness of using a calculated model of a sinus stator winding in order to increase the efficiency of mathematical modeling using the equivalent of a field model with a fixed rotor and slip frequency using a circular model.

articleTitle: 5G Technology as the Succesive Stage in the History of Wireless Telecommunication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Nowadays in Europe there is very emotional discussion on the 5G technology and its bad or good influence on human health. The paper aims at showing the history and development of wireless telecommunication and attempts to answer very essential question: why the 5G technology is neither dangerous nor hazardous for human health to the extent dramatically bigger the previous generations of wireless telecommunication. The last decades brought a lot of research projects which were devoted to investigation of how the mobile phones influence the human health. The paper is to show that the 5G technology is the continuation of technological process and then the results of previous investigations can be extended to 5G technology.

articleTitle: Simulation of Factory with Alternative Sources Used to Reduce Its Own Power Supply Using Matlab
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This article deals with the operations control of factory with alternative sources used to reduce its own power supply. The basic conditions of this operation (factory operation conditions and algorithm conditions of controllers) are formulated. Two equivalent circuits with mathematical models were created. Created models are intended for use in control programs to calculate and predict all possible operating conditions and select the most appropriate state. First model is based on currents and second model is based on power for describing factory operations. Example of simulation of created control algorithm using Matlab is shown.

articleTitle: Construction and Adjustment Of a Vibration Machine Based on a Complete Electric Drive
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The engineering method of parameters determination of the vibrating machine electric drive for concrete products compacting at creation on the basis of modern complete electric drives is given. It is proposed to adjust the resonant mode of the vibrator due to the calculated parameters of a two-stage elastic suspension during vector control of an induction motor.

articleTitle: Dual Electromagnetic Retarder Control System for Tuning Internal Combustion Engines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
