abstract: A preliminary analysis and synthesis of structural, functional diagrams of the control system of two electromagnetic retarders connected to the driving wheels of the car, to ensure the adjustment of the fuel system of the internal combustion engine, was performed. When developing the system, the mechanical connection of the wheels through the gearbox and the differential bridge was taken into account. For precise adjustment of the ignition timing and fuel mixture composition, the control system of electromagnetic retarders must operate in two modes - start to the desired speed of the internal combustion engine with simultaneous rotation of both wheels with a minimum total load torque and stabilize this speed throughout the gas pedal position range. It is shown that to solve the task, the control system can be built both with two PI-wheel speed controllers with a common master signal, and with a more complex dual 2-circuit system with current and speed control. Also, taking into account the non-linear dependence of the torque of electromagnetic clutches on current and speed, fractional-integral regulators can be applied. The final decision on the regulatory structure will be made after testing the control system. In the future, we plan to upgrade the system for four-wheel drive cars.

articleTitle: Numerical Evaluation of the Maximum Heatings of Solid Rotor of the Synchronous Machine in Transient Mode
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The values of the maximum temperatures and the influence of their deviations from the experimental data on the assessment of the actual thermal stability of the structure have been analyzed on the basis of a comparison of the experimental and calculated values of the heating of the elements of the solid rotor of a synchronous machine. The low adequacy of experimental methods of the assessment of solid toothed rotors thermal stability has been proved. A model and methods for the essential improvement of the accuracy of determination of the rotor surface temperature with the use of a combined calculation-experimental approach have been developed. The calculation efficiency depending on the depth and position of placing thermocouples has been researched.

articleTitle: Investigation of Leakage Inductance Influence on Torque Characteristic of Different Types of Induction Machines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The main objective of this study was to investigate the influence of leakage inductance of different types of induction machines on the resulting torque characteristic. The study was focused on three phase induction machines that are most often used in the industry with special emphases on the induction machine configuration with squirrel cage rotor. Based on the known analytical solutions the leakage inductance components were calculated for different types of stator and rotor geometry slots and winding profiles. Special emphasis was put on analysis and comparison of analytical solutions proposed by Pyrhönen and Boldea-Nasar. Based on the analyzed analytical solutions we developed a programing Matlab script code, which can serve as an important tool in designing and analysis the induction machine characteristics.

articleTitle: Automatic Regulation of Parameters to Render Harmless Chromium Containing Waste Water in a Mixer-Reactor of Periodical Action
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The method is suggested for automatic regulation of parameters to render harmless chromium-containing waste waters in a mixer-reactor of periodical action. The method consists in a stage-by-stage dosing reagents into water for the gradual decrease of redox potential (Eh) to limiting value with the continuous maintenance of the value of active reaction within given boundaries. The control over dosing of reagents is carried out by local regulators the adjustment of which parameters is determined for each stage and the period of regulation. The mathematical model is developed for a mixer-reactor of periodical action as an object of control with the changeable structure and methods of synthesizing local systems of regulating parameters Eh and pH. The mathematical model is built for controlling system and the stage-by-stage modelling is implemented in the process of removing six-valency chromium.

articleTitle: Research of PMSM Wind Generator Under Assymetry Grid Conditions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The use of renewable energy sources is an important area of energy development that allows to solve a complex of environmental and social problems. The permanent magnet synchronous generator is the most popular type for wind turbines with variable speed and no gear. The connection of such a generator to the grid is carried out through a bidirectional converter in which the control of the generator-side is carried out on the principles of vector control with the machine flux orientation, and the grid-side converter is providing control with the use of voltage orientation principle. The paper presents the research of the operation of a wind turbine with a voltage-orientation principle for grid-side converter when an asymmetry of grid's voltage appears.

articleTitle: Modelling the Electromagnetic Processes and Phenomena in Quantum-Sized Systems in the Course of Physical and Mathematical Support of Master’s Programs for the “Electric Power Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Electromechanics Specialty”
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with the use of mathematical computer modelling for the study of processes and phenomena in quantum-sized heterosystems.The use of computer algebra MathCad and Scilab systems allows us to study the characteristics of electromagnetic oscillations, the representation of periodic signals in the form of harmonic series, as well as to consider the state of electrons in different quantum dots (QD) and to determine the discrete spectrum of natural energies and its dependence on the geometric form and QD parameters.The results of the research are implemented in the laboratory workshop of the discipline of physical and mathematical support of Master's programs for students of the “Power Engineering, Electrical Engineering and Electromechanics Specialty”.

Author Keywords: discipline practice physical and mathematical support of master’s programs

articleTitle: Modular Principle in the Structural organization and Evolution of Electromechanical Objects
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The tendency of transition to a modular strategy in the technical evolution of complex technical systems is analyzed. The system nature of the modular organization of electromechanical objects is shown. The analysis of the levels of structural organization is carried out. The corresponding elemental basis of modular structures is determined. The interrelated genetic principles of replication and structural isomerism are shown as the systemic basis of the formation of modular electromagnetic structures. The reliability of the proposed models and methods of synthesis is confirmed by the data of evolutionary experiments.

articleTitle: Justification of Construction Parameters of the Screen in the Small-Sized Household Biomass Chopper
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The mechanism of influence of screen design parameters on the technological process and the particle size distribution of the chopped biomass were determined in this research. The presented engineering solutions make it possible to design the screen for chopping the given biomass material. The modernized construction expands the scope of application of small-sized chopper, especially when used in private farm households. Size control of the chopped material allows to use material as fuel, material for mulching of berry plantations and gardens, material for production of constructional and insulating wood concrete.

articleTitle: Aspects of Forming the Information V2I Model of the Transport Vessel
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article describes the aspects of forming the information V2I model, the process of preparation, monitoring and assessment of the technical state of the transport vessel power plant under operating conditions with the possibility of predicting its technical state. The authors developed an informational V2I model, which is characterized by the vibrational field of the transport vessel, means of monitoring of the technical state parameters and infrastructure components for monitoring any transport vessel. The main idea is to implement information monitoring system designed to ensure the efficient operation of the vehicle in non-stationary operating conditions, characterized by the lack of quality data transmission networks.

articleTitle: Observer-based Sensorless Control of PMSM
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: This paper presents designs of the new state observers (SO) for sensorless field-oriented vector control (FOC) systems of synchronous motors with interior magnets (IPMSM). Observers are based on the motor models in the rotor reference frame. Input signal of SO is torque producing stator voltage and correction signal is stator current estimation error. Observers estimate unmeasured load torque without the use of an additional integrator. The observed load torque is utilized for the compensation of the speed estimation error and speed decrease in the closed loop system by torque load presence. Equations are derived for calculating the coefficients of the observer's corrective coupling from the condition of providing the desired characteristic polynomial of SO. An expression is found for calculating the speed estimation error in the steady state mode when the system responds to the changes in load torque. The simulation results are given.

articleTitle: Improving of the Electronic Intellectual Cleaning System of Holes in Perforated Shells of the Priller
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The main disadvantages in the work of prillers to obtain the monodispersed drops while clogging the holes in the perforated shell, were analyzed. The electronic intellectual system to control the operation of the electromagnetic vibrator, enabling to carry out periodical cleaning of holes, was proposed. Using the control panel of the vibration frequency, the system lets to impose high-frequency oscillations on the perforated shell of the priller, which cause to the cleaning of holes from pollutions. The proposed electric intellectual system has been tested and ways of its further improvement have been outlined.

articleTitle: The Assessment of the Efficiency of a Pumping Plant with a Variable-Frequency Electric Drive at the Change of the Hydraulic System Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: It is shown that in the process of long-term operation of pumping plants with variable-frequency electric drives the parameters of the pumping and pipeline equipment change. The paper presents a mathematical model of a variable-frequency electric drive system, which makes it possible to assess the pumping and pipeline equipment parameter deviation influence on the efficiency of the system. It has been determined that the increase in the pump hydraulic resistance has a significant impact on the efficiency of the pump unit, and the hydraulic resistance of the pipeline network affects the possibility of working out the technological task of stabilizing the pressure in the pipeline network. An analytical expression describing the pump efficiency dependence on the changes in the hydraulic system parameters is proposed.

articleTitle: Overviewing of the Impact of Wind Farm Integration on Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The increased installed wind power impact the transmission grid due to predicting production difficulty, grid capacity, the risk of untimely disconnection of wind farms and the quality electricity degradation. This paper presents a summary of the integration of wind turbines on power grid with low rate of penetration. research results have demonstrated the quality of electrical energy injected by wind farms composed of DFIG, and their particularity to control the active and reactive flow of the grid and a good performance at the level of voltage and frequency.

Author Keywords: integration and isolation of wind turbines

articleTitle: The Torque of Undulated-Current Traction Motors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article examines the system of impulse power supply of mine contact electric locomotives traction network with two-phase alternating-current rectification where due to valve key elements the current impulse is supplied from the source (power transformer) to the electric locomotive engine within the time-limit of 2/3 of period for each period, while the pause in power line current is made during the other 1/3 of period by locking of the line by the valve plug.During the pause traction motors are by-passed with the connected against the current source valve being opened for a period of pause by a reverse voltage source.The article presents that the energy is discharged in the engine's own circle within the pause at impulse power supply due to the use of reactive energy accumulated in engines for the duration of the current impulse, providing the increase of engines torque comparing with the DC power supply. The effect being mentioned provides the possibility to improve the traction characteristics of electric locomotives or to minimize the power consumption of power supply system without traction properties of electric motors being impaired.

articleTitle: Analysis of Direct Torque Control System of Five-Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In the work by mathematical modeling, an analysis of the functioning of the direct torque control system of a five-phase induction motor with a table of optimal switching, using only space voltage vectors with the maximum value, as well as with the use of the modified multi-level relay torque controller with the corresponding correction of the table of optimal switching, was performed. It has been proved that the use of multi-level relay torque controller can improve the accuracy of the torque control and reduce the level of torque ripples for five-phase induction motor drive.

articleTitle: Genetic Synthesis of Electromechanical Objects of the Modular Type
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Fundamental and universal nature of genetic principles of electromagnetic and electromechanical systems structural organization is shown in the following article. Macrogenetic programs of structuring with the maximum genetic predisposition to modularity are determined and analyzed. Genetic models of multilevel synthesis of modular electromagnetic and electromechanical structures have been developed. The reliability of the proposed models and methods of synthesis is confirmed by the results of the synthesis of various types of electromechanical objects of the modular type.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Electric Drive Based on Cascade Multi-Level Frequency Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of using cascade multi-level frequency converters in an asynchronous electric drive. The features of building a power part of the frequency converter are shown. The comparison of the elements in the power part of the frequency converter is done. The output voltage vectors depending on the switching of the power switches of the frequency converter are shown. The schemes of substitution are considered which allows simplify the mathematical models of the system. The study of transient processes with different voltage amplitudes of the source is carried out, the harmonic coefficient is shown.

articleTitle: Methodical Approach to Evaluate Management Efficiency of Energy Supply Companies
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article proposes a methodical approach that allows to comprehensively evaluate management efficiency of energy supply companies. This methodical approach is based on the formation of primary and complex indicators with isolation of influence factors of the internal and external environment. The proposed methodical approach allows to determine the overall level of management efficiency of energy supply companies by forming an integral indicator that reflects the complex assessment of management efficiency of energy supply companies and creates conditions for multivector assessment of management effectiveness. Approbation of the proposed methodical approach was carried out on the example of energy supply companies of the south-eastern region of Ukraine, among which there are PJSC “Khersonoblenergo”, PJSC “Odessaoblenergo”, PJSC “Mykolayivoblenergo ”, PJSC “Zaporizhzhiaoblenergo”.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Quasi-Optimal in Speed Relay-Modal Position Control System, Based on the N-I Switching Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The mathematical apparatus of the N - i switching method, due to its simplicity, made it possible to find out relations between the parameters of relay-modal and quasi-optimal in speed sliding mode control systems. Initially, this result was formulated for control systems of neutral-stable dynamic objects. This paper presents a comparative study of the dynamics of systems with different settings. Based on it, an adaptation of the optimization method for the speed of relay-modal systems to the synthesis of a regulators cascade for positional electric drive is proposed.

articleTitle: Introduction to the Formation of the Basic Structure of the Algorithm for the Control of Electric Energy Flows in Iron Ore Mines
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to develop formalized procedures for determining baseline indicators for electricity consumption for underground iron ore enterprises. Scientific novelty consists in the implementation of methods of economic-statistical analysis to the practice of formalizing the indicators of the level of electricity consumption. The lack of universality reflects the feasibility of constructing regression models for each iron ore enterprises. The proposed methods allow us to form a system of indicators for determining the levels of electricity consumption by iron ore enterprises. Recommendations are offered according to each enterprise individually, in relation to the formation of effective management actions on electric consumption.

articleTitle: Operation Modes of Electric Motors of Reversing Cold Rolling Mill 1680 while Rolling with Emulsions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The conditions of operation of reversible cold rolling mills from the point of view of the characteristics of the power load on electric motors are considered in the paper. The necessity of ensuring the reliability and stability of the modes of electrical, control and automation equipment is provided to achieve the high quality and absence of folder defects in thin cold rolled strips. The necessity of rolling with special emulsions has been substantiated. The research of operation of the electric motor of a reverse cold rolling mill and two coilers while rolling by plant modes using "Universal-TS" and "ColdRoller" emulsions was performed. Favorable softening of the rolling conditions from the point of view of the detected amperages in the electric motors of the rolling mill has been established.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Frequency and Phase Comparators for Closed-Loop Motor Position Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A novel engineering solution for all-digital frequency and phase comparators is proposed, implemented and tested. It is not only allows to measure the inequality sign between two periodic processes but also the numeric degree of difference between them. They in turn can be used for regulator input value, or directly for modulator input. Both comparators were implemented scalable using generic features of hardware description language, and were equipped with synchronous pulse shorteners and edge detectors, which increases the noise immunity and solves problem of detection of almost equal frequencies and phases, that in turn, resolved of two actual engineering tasks that is grew based on analysis of existing similar blocks. Proposed blocks can be used for motor control purposes in pulse-frequency domain (or spike-based domain) or as a part of control system for quasi-resonant converters for directly processing of feedback signals from Hall-sensors and reference moving generator that results in robustness of control system and reducing of its complexity.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Buck DC-DC Converter Switching
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper contains transient analysis of standard buck DC-DC converter. Transient analysis consists of two intervals, which represents two states of switching. For the transient analysis calculations was used Laplace-Carson transformation. At the end of the article there is also showed example of practical use of the transient analysis for creating simulation model.

articleTitle: Experimental Laboratory Equipped with Voltage Dividers for Power Quality Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Benefits that can be obtained from replacing electromagnetic type instrument voltage transformers with voltage dividers in electrical networks are shown. In order to improve the accuracy of power quality measurement within the framework of the Smart Grid concept, it is proposed to use broadband resistive-capacitive type voltage dividers. The tasks and stages of a pilot project on the development of laboratory equipped with three broadband voltage dividers, intended for comprehensive monitoring of electrical energy quality are described. Summary on possible application area of voltage dividers in electrical networks is given.

articleTitle: Energetic Complex for the Plastic’s Waste Processing and Electricity Production
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The problem of the rational plastic's waste utilization is reviewed. It is shown that it is one of the most effective method of the plastic's waste processing into the artificial liquid fuel and its conversion into electrical power. The experience of previous researches and development, the analysis of constructive solutions and the results of experiments gave the reason to apply a technological solution with three reactors for the plastic waste processing. The economically efficient energetic complexes for wastes the plastic waste processing and electricity production is proved. The advantages of the proposed controlled thermo-catalytic plastic waste processing method are shown.

articleTitle: Four-Wire Three-Phase Active Power Filter With Fuzzy Controller For Compensation Of Distortion of Currents Unbalance in the Conditions of Fluctuated Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The methods of control for active power filters are based on modern understanding the power's components. Theoretical insights concerning the definition of inactive components of power, among which pq-and pqr-theory of instantaneous power stand out, are used to determine the specified current of the active power filter. At the same time, a significant indicator of the quality of the device in general is the process of adjustment of current. On the basis of the analysis of known works, it was figured out that the parameters of the compensator's closed-loop current controller shall be defined by the load mode which very often is changeable. Thus the need for adjusting the parameters of the controller arises. The results of previous studies have shown that special based on fuzzy logic approach can be used to adjust the coefficients of the controller. The controller, which is designed using fuzzy logic for correction integral and differential terms, was proposed. The model of a four-wire three-phase power active filter with a fuzzy controller for compensation of distortions of currents unbalances under variable load mode was developed using the graphical programming entwinement. During the study, it was found that the current and power unbalance does not exceed 1% for the calculated mode. Conclusions of research has shown that the current and power imbalance does not exceed 1% for the calculated mode.

articleTitle: Caching and Archiving in Distributed System for Effective Information Collection and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The resource optimization method in distributed system of data collection and analysis is proposed by reducing system traffic due to caching and load distribution among system parts depending on a type of the collected data. Reducing the traffic by caching is a part of “local server” functionality that does not send data if absolute difference with previously sent data is lower than some configured constant. Load distribution is provided by dividing the messages in three types: alarm, cached, and simple data, where different types of messages have different destination paths and processing scenarios. Archiving on a “local server” for sending the cached data is used in cases when the accurate data are needed.

articleTitle: Study of AC Pulse Converters with Active and Active-Inductive Load
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the analysis of AC pulse converters with active and active-inductive load. The mathematical model for the analysis of electromagnetic processes in the semiconductor converter with pulse-width regulation of the output voltage has been developed. The problem of using the method of multiparametric modulating functions has been solved during the research.

articleTitle: Degradation and Regeneration in Silicon Concentrator Solar Panels
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The potential induced degradation features in solar batteries elements and their regeneration problem are analyzed. The PID models for single-crystalline silicon solar cells are developed. The experimental results of accelerated thermocycling tests for solar cell fragment are presented.

articleTitle: Psychological and Pedagogical Aspects of Identifying the Professional Abilities in Electrical Engineering of Listeners of the Pre-University Training Course
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The psychological and pedagogical aspects of identifying the professional abilities in electrical engineering from the graduates of general educational institutions are analyzed. The diagnostics of individual peculiarities in students of the university’s preparatory courses by methods of professional orientation and professional selection has been provided. The method of determining of directions for pre-university training of students through the questioning of professional interests, formation and phased development of their personal professional-oriented interests is offered. The complex of methods of the individual approach for identifying the professional abilities of entrants in electrical engineering is determined. The psychological requirements for future specialists in the field of electrical engineering are established.

articleTitle: Investigation of Factors Affecting on the forms of Pulsed Dielectrical Barrier Discharge on the Surface of Water in Atmospheric Air
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The possibility of existence of a uniform pulsed dielectric barrier discharge in atmospheric air with the presence of water in it in a drop-film state is shown. The discharge was created in plane-parallel gap of 3 mm length by unipolar voltage pulses with fronts of about 40 ns and amplitudes 27 kV. Researches were made in the presence of a dielectric barrier on one of the electrodes. The characteristic diameter of droplets was 1 mm and tap water film on the gas gap walls 0.1 mm. The following discharge parameters were achieved for these conditions: the intensity of the electric field in the gap was almost 60 kV/cm, the current density - 2.6 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the concentration of electrons - 8.5·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup>Cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and their average energy - 3.7 eV. With increasing frequency of repetition of pulses of voltage over 300 Hz zones with bright filamentous formations appear in the gas gap. The frequency of the transition of a discharge into a non-uniform becomes considerably higher (over 500 Hz) in condition of transverse purge of the gap by air, its velocity being 0.6 m/s at the entrance to the electrode system. It is proved that one of the main conditions of a uniform discharge existence was gas gap cooling by continuous motion of water film on its walls and the air blowing through it.

Author Keywords: uniform and non-uniform pulsed dielectrical barrier discharge

articleTitle: Development of Power Supply for Resistance Welding Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A method for controlling a single-phase high-frequency power supply for resistance welding machine has been developed. It allows operation with improved power factor and low harmonic distortion of the mains current waveshape. A prototype of the power supply of resistance welding machine has been developed. Experimental verification of the developed power supply of resistance welding machine confirmed the correctness of the results obtained as a result of mathematical modeling and the high efficiency of the developed power supply.

articleTitle: Feed Forward Robust Active Shielding System by Magnetic Field with Single Compensating Coil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: For the first time the synthesis of feed forward robust single-circuit active shielding system of magnetic field, generated by group of high voltage power lines for reducing the induction of the initial magnetic field to the sanitary standards level and reducing the sensitivity of the system to variations in the plant parameters is given. The synthesis is based on the solution of a multi-criteria stochastic game, in which the gain vector is calculated on the basis of the Maxwell equations solutions in the quasi-stationary approximation. The equilibrium state of the game is based on the stochastic multiagent optimization algorithms by multiswarm particles. Computer simulation and field experimental research results of feed forward robust single-circuit active shielding system of magnetic field, generated by group of high voltage power lines are given.

Author Keywords: feed forward robust single-circuit active shielding system
computer simulation and field experimental research results

articleTitle: Research Levels and Zones Spatial Propagation of the Magnetic Field of the Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The safe geometric arrangement of workplace spaces for a relatively concentrated electrical equipment is established. It is noticed that the magnitude of the induction of the magnetic field of the induction motor is largely influenced by the direction of its rotation. The regression model of the induction magnetic field distribution of an induction motor is obtained, which allows taking into account the distance to the machine, its geometric location, and calculates the magnitude and character of the distribution of induction, both from the supply of industrial frequency and from the sources of energy conversion, in particular, frequency converters, which create additional electromagnetic pollution of the environment, increasing the negative impact on the health of workers.

articleTitle: The Method of Protective Screen Selection Against the Excessive Influence of the Electromagnetic Field of an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper presents the results of experimental investigations of the propagation of the magnetic field induction from asynchronous machines in production conditions. It is established that the propagation of the induction of the magnetic field of an induction motor is influenced by it's power, the distance to it and the type of protective screen. The graph-analytical method of determining the type and design of a protective screen is proposed, which makes it possible to reduce the negative influence of electromagnetic field on human health.

articleTitle: Results of Researches of Metrological Characteristics of Analog Temperature Sensors
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The patterns of the dynamics of the errors of serial analog temperature sensors have been established. The hardware-and-software method to increase the accuracy of serial analog temperature sensors has been proposed. The regularity of changes in the errors of serial analog temperature sensors has been established. The type and parameters of the simplified parametric equation, which is obtained on the basis of the Steinhart-Hart equation for the analog temperature sensor KY013, have been detected. When conducting experimental studies, it was found that in the temperature range from 10 to 40°C regulated for greenhouse production, the use of a KY-013 sensor provides an absolute measurement error no more than ±0.20°C. The possibility of introduction and application of these sensors in real technological processes of enterprises has also been substantiated. The scientific novelty of the results obtained consists in determining the type and parameters of the empirical calibration equation for the analog temperature sensor. The practical significance of the results lies in the improvement of the automated method of calibration of modern low-cost analog temperature sensors.

articleTitle: Accounting of Electric Energy Consumption and Quality as a Part Of Automatic Systems of Technical Accounting of Energy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The basic problems of energy consumption and the assessment of the quality of electric energy in low-voltage three-phase distribution power networks of typical industrial and municipal objects are considered. The new criteria of the assessment of low-quality individual and group load are introduced and approbated in practice. Approaches to the identification of the influence of particular consumers by the results of the matrix analysis of instantaneous power components are proposed.

articleTitle: Economic Efficiency of a Photovoltaic Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article presents the economic aspects of investments in photovoltaic power plants. Factors that significantly influence the assessment of investment profitability are described. In the article, the authors presented the results of simulation of investment profitability in a micro PV installation with a capacity of 50kW. The profitability analysis was carried out using two methods: DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) and IRR (Internal Rate of Return). The DCF method allows for the market calculation of the investment value under the assumed conditions and the discount rate. The second one allows to compare the economic efficiency of the investment.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform Potential for Localization of Leakages in the Pumping Complex Pipeline Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper deals with the wavelet transform potential for localization of leakages in the pumping complex pipeline network. The relationship of wave processes in the head signals and the change of the wavelet coefficients in the time and frequency domain are determined. It is proved that the beginning of the emergency mode corresponds to the first abrupt change in the root-mean-square values of the wavelet coefficients in the head signal. To identify the coordinate of the leakage in the pipeline network it is proposed to use the time moments of the first abrupt change of the root-mean-square values of the wavelet coefficients. It is found that the error of determining the location of a leakage is affected by the geometry of the pipeline, the speed of the shock wave propagation, the type of the leakage and its volume. The obtained theoretical results are confirmed experimentally in a pumping complex laboratory setup.

articleTitle: Complex Permeability Hysteresis Model for Implementation in Harmonic Balance Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A mathematical model of scalar hysteresis in a ferromagnetic medium is formulated. The model is based on the concept of complex magnetic permeability, including analytical expressions like the Fröhlich functions. The initial data of the complex permeability obtained from the Preisach hysteresis model. The features of the algorithm taking into consideration hysteresis phenomena in the harmonic balance method are formulated. Influence of the hesitating behavior of the solution is taking into account by the sign of the derivative of the main harmonic which determines the branch of the hysteresis loop.

articleTitle: Thermal Process in Compound-Structure Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The mathematical model of the thermal process in compound-structure permanent-magnet synchronous machine is considered in the work. The compound-structure permanent-magnet synchronous machine (CS-PMSM), comprising a double rotor machine (DRM) and a permanent-magnet (PM) motor. For CS-PMSM, it is very important to know the temperature rise and heat dissipation, especially when CS-PMSM is operating at full load. From a mathematical point of view, an compound-structure permanent-magnet synchronous machine is viewed in the form of a complex nine-layer area. In this area, as a mathematical model of the thermal process, a boundary-value problem with external and internal heat sources in a cylindrical coordinate system is proposed. A feature of the mathematical model is that at the boundaries of the layers, the condition of perfect thermal contact is used in the form of equality of derivatives in the direction of a given vector. The problem is solved by the finite element method. The multilayer continuous region is represented as a grid of a separable triangulation domain. After triangulation, the solution of the differential problem is reduced to solving a system of algebraic equations with a sparse matrix of the system. The paper also considered another approach to the study of thermal processes in CS-PMSM, which uses the method of parallel structures.

articleTitle: Modelling of Output Signal of Magnetoelastic Pressure Force Sensor 120kN
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The article deals with modelling of magnetic field and output signal of 120 kN magnetoelastic force sensor. Elastomagnetic sensor belong to the group of nonlinear systems. They are based on Virallís phenomenon. Output sibnal from sensor is proportional to change of permeability which leads to deformation of magnetic field.

articleTitle: Partially Feedback Linearizing DC-Link Voltage Controller for Three-Phase Shunt Active Power Filters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: In this paper, a novel partially feedback linearizing DC-link voltage control algorithm for shunt active power filters is presented. The nonlinear dynamic second-order voltage controller guarantees: a) asymptotic average DC-link voltage regulation; b) reconstruction of the current reference derivative; c) filtering properties of the DC-link voltage control loop with respect to the perturbations generated by the high-order active filter current harmonics. The modified current controllers provide harmonic distortions rejection, while voltage controller guarantees keeping the DC-link voltage in admissible range. The simulation study proofs theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Increase of Electromagnetic Compatibility of the Rotary Type Electromagnetic Separator with Semiconductor Current Regulators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The separation subsystem was developed, which allows improve the compensation methods of current non-active components under the nonlinearity of the load, like a rotary type electromagnetic separator. It is realized by the excluding of the harmonic voltage components, caused by distortion of the network, of forming the compensation currents. It allows to increase the efficiency of the power supply systems and to improve the performance of the compensation system. A new method of optimal magnetization windings current and performance control using fuzzy logic was developed. It has the following optimal criteria: minimum power consumption, maximum efficiency, maximum quality of consumption current for a given output quality and the fuzzy proportional-integral current control method in magnetization windings electromagnetic separator. The appropriate ranges of variation and functional correlations of the parameters of the universal current harmonics filter were determined for various nominal input currents of the system, thanks to which filters were developed that reduce the level of current harmonics consumed by the system from the network.

articleTitle: Improving of Accuracy of Electromechanical Servo Systems with Distributed Parameter of Plant Mechanical Part
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The method of multiobjective synthesis of nonlinear robust electromechanical servo systems with distributed parameter of plant mechanical part and with parametric uncertainty is developed. Synthesis of nonlinear robust controllers and nonlinear robust observers reduces to solving the system of Hamilton-Jacobi-Isaacs equations. Target vector of robust control is determined by solving the multicriterion nonlinear programming problem in which the components of the vectors of the objective function are direct quality indicators that are presented to the system in various modes of its operation. The calculation of the vectors of the objective function and constraints is algorithmic and associated with synthesis of nonlinear robust controllers and modeling of the synthesized system for various modes of operation of the system, with different input signals and for various values of the plant parameters. The results of the dynamic characteristics modeling of a synthesized nonlinear electromechanical servo system are presented.

Author Keywords: distributed parameter of plant mechanical part

articleTitle: Development of the Mathematical Apparatus for the Neural Adaptive Electric Drive Control System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The advantages and disadvantages of using the artificial neural networks for automatic control of alternate current electric drives are considered. The research and the existing methods for operation control using artificial neural networks are analyzed. The typical schemes of using the neural networks in the control circuit are analyzed. It was proposed to implement developed artificial neural network to verify its operation using mathematical simulation. Based on the conducted researches it was grounded the use of neural networks in alternate current electric drive automatic control systems.

articleTitle: Concept of Anti-Surge Protection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: The paper is devoted to research of anti-shock systems of protection and mathematical modeling of systems of gas pumping units on the basis of centrifugal compressors with electric drive engine. The modern methodology for the synthesis of control systems involves the use of a system, in particular object-oriented approach. System representations of complex technological systems give their object models. The utility of object models is that on their basis it is convenient to develop control systems for specific aggregates, providing modern requirements for modularity and limiting the access of structural subsystems of the integrated control system.

articleTitle: Modeling a Non-Contact Sustainable Suspension of a Free Superconducting Rotor on Magnetic Bearings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: Mathematical models of constructions of superconducting magnetic bearings to create a contactless rotor with six degrees of freedom have been studied. A comparative analysis of methods and design possibilities of stationary rotors with vertical and horizontal axes of rotation in the magnetic field of the stator has been held. The formula of the total potential energy of an electromechanical system with superconducting magnetic coils depending on coordinates of the position of the heavy rotor relative to the stator is obtained. Conditions of static and dynamic resistance of the rotor in the suspension are studied. Ways to increase the suspension rigidity are proposed.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wind Turbine Impacts on Power Quality Taking into Account the Variable Nature of Wind Flow
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: A new method for modeling the wind flow based on modeling using recurrent difference equations is proposed. The correlation function obtained by choosing the spectral density of the Kaimal model was the main characteristic of modeling turbulent wind flow. A model of a wind power plant based on doubly fed induction generator has been developed in Simulink as a source of voltage distortion and voltage fluctuations. The dependences of the voltage total harmonic distortion parameters from correlation function damping coefficient and standard deviation of the wind flow are obtained and analyze.

articleTitle: The Capacitor Field Modelling by Comsol
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Modern Electrical and Energy Systems (MEES)
abstract: in the paper, the analysis of the capacitor electromagnetic field by means of program Comsol and comparison of obtained results with those ones obtained by the theoretical calculation based on the corresponding analytic expressions is presented. Study was done for two types of capacitor field: stationary one and frequency dependent one. For stationary fields, capacitor capacitance and total capacitor field energy are expressed and compared, for a frequency dependent field they are capacitor admittance and total capacitor field energy.
